title: The Painting Challenge
description: A man in a dark suit holding a coffee cup stands beside a large retro-futuristic green machine on a stand inside a dimly lit room. Behind them hangs a large gruesome painting depicting a silhouetted figure with an axe standing over a bloody crawling victim in a hallway with an illuminated exit sign.
